सबसे ऊँचे जलप्रपातों में से एक है, निम्नलिखित में से
किस नदी पर स्थित है?
questions.source: AI-generated from supplied reference material; Physical and Political Geography of India
questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question_english:
17. The famous Jog Falls (Gersoppa Falls), one of the
highest waterfalls in India, is located on which
of the following rivers?
questions.explanation_english:
Jog Falls, also known as Gersoppa Falls, is one of
the highest untiered plunge waterfalls in India,
dropping down a cliff face of approximately
two hundred fifty-three meters. Located in the
Shivamogga district of Karnataka, this dramatic
waterfall is created by the Sharavati River as it
flows through the dense, rugged evergreen forests
of the Western Ghats toward the Arabian Sea.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। जोग जलप्रपात, जिसे गेरसोप्पा जलप्रपात भी कहा जाता है, भारत के सबसे ऊँचे जलप्रपातों में से एक है। यह जलप्रपात लगभग 253 मीटर की ऊँचाई से गिरता है और कर्नाटक के शिवमोग्गा जिले में स्थित है। यह शरावती नदी द्वारा निर्मित होता है, जो पश्चिमी घाट के घने, दुर्गम सदाबहार जंगलों के बीच बहती है।
questions.topic: Physical and Political Geography of India
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Sharavati River
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Jog Falls is created by the Sharavati River.

questions.question_english:
12. Below are two statements, one labeled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R):
Assertion (A): Rivers originating from the Peninsular Plateau do not form extensive deltas on the West Coast of India.
Reason (R): West-flowing Peninsular rivers have short courses and flow through steep gradients, carrying low sediment loads into estuaries.
In the context of the above statements, which one of the following options is correct?
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A.
A is true but R is false.
A is false but R is true.
questions.explanation_english: Both statements A and R are true. Rivers originating from the Western Ghats and flowing westward into the Arabian Sea do not build large coastal deltas. Because the Western Ghats lie close to the coast, these rivers traverse short distances over steep gradients with swift currents. Consequently, they carry minimal alluvial sediment and discharge their load directly into deep ocean waters, forming estuaries rather than extensive prograding delta networks.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। प्रायद्वीपीय पठार से उत्पन्न नदियाँ, जो पश्चिम की ओर बहती हैं, विस्तृत डेल्टा नहीं बनातीं। पश्चिमी घाट तट के निकट स्थित हैं, जिससे ये नदियाँ कम दूरी पर तीव्र ढलानों से बहती हैं और कम तलछट लाती हैं। इसलिए, ये सीधे गहरे समुद्र में अपना जल छोड़ती हैं और डेल्टा के बजाय मुहाने बनाती हैं।
questions.topic: Physical and Political Geography of India

questions.source: AI-generated from supplied reference material; Physical and Political Geography of India
questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question_english: 85. Which metallic mineral are the Balaghat and Jhunjhunu districts in India prominent producers of?
questions.explanation_english:
Balaghat district in Madhya Pradesh and
Jhunjhunu district in Rajasthan host major
domestic reserves of copper ore in India. The
Malanjkhand belt in Balaghat represents the
largest open-cast copper mine complex in
the country, while the Khetri copper belt in
Jhunjhunu features deep underground mining
operations. Together, these geological formations
provide essential raw ore for copper extraction
and refining industries.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। बालाघाट जिला मध्य प्रदेश में और झुंझुनू जिला राजस्थान में भारत में तांबे के अयस्क के प्रमुख घरेलू भंडारों का घर है। बालाघाट में मलांजखंड बेल्ट देश का सबसे बड़ा ओपन-कास्ट तांबा खदान परिसर है, जबकि झुंझुनू में खेत्रि तांबा बेल्ट गहरे भूमिगत खनन संचालन की विशेषता रखती है। ये भूवैज्ञानिक संरचनाएँ तांबा निष्कर्षण और परिष्करण उद्योगों के लिए आवश्यक कच्चे अयस्क प्रदान करती हैं।
questions.topic: Physical and Political Geography of India
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Copper
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Balaghat district in Madhya Pradesh and Jhunjhunu district in Rajasthan host major domestic reserves of copper ore in India.

Karakoram Range in the Himalayas, just
northeast of Point NJ9842 where the Line of

military battlefield on Earth.

जहां नियंत्रण रेखा समाप्त होती है। यह लगभग
छियासी किलोमीटर लंबा है, और यह दुनिया के
सबसे लंबे गैर-ध्रुवीय ग्लेशियरों में से एक है।
यह पांच हजार मीटर से अधिक की ऊँचाई पर

सैन्य युद्धक्षेत्र के रूप में रणनीतिक महत्व
रखता है।

questions.question_english: 81. Which iron and steel plant in India was established with the assistance of the former USSR at Bhilai?
questions.explanation_english: The Bhilai Steel Plant, located in Durg district of Chhattisgarh, was established in 1955 under a bilateral technical collaboration agreement between India and the former Soviet Union (USSR). Utilizing local iron ore from Dalli Rajhara and coal from Jharia, Bhilai became one of India’s premier public sector steel plants, playing a foundational role in building national heavy industrial and rail transport infrastructure.

C. तेलंगाना राज्य में सबसे ऊँची चोटी डोली गुट्टा है जो तेलंगाना और छत्तीसगढ़ की सीमा पर स्थित है।

questions.question_english:
40. Evaluate the following statements regarding the geography of Telangana State:
A. Telangana is a completely landlocked state situated on the Deccan Plateau.
B. It shares physical boundaries with four states: Maharashtra, Karnataka, Chhattisgarh, and Andhra Pradesh.
C. The highest peak in Telangana State is Doli Gutta located on the border of Telangana and Chhattisgarh.
Which of the statements above is/are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Telangana is a landlocked state located on the semi-arid Deccan Plateau in southern India. It shares land boundaries with four states: Maharashtra to the north, Karnataka to the west, Chhattisgarh to the northeast, and Andhra Pradesh to the south and east. The highest geographical elevation in Telangana is Doli Gutta peak, standing on the eastern border shared between Telangana and Chhattisgarh.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। तेलंगाना एक भूमि-लॉक राज्य है जो दक्षिण भारत के अर्ध-शुष्क डेक्कन पठार पर स्थित है। यह चार राज्यों: महाराष्ट्र, कर्नाटक, छत्तीसगढ़, और आंध्र प्रदेश के साथ भौतिक सीमाएँ साझा करता है। तेलंगाना में सबसे ऊँची चोटी डोली गुट्टा है, जो तेलंगाना और छत्तीसगढ़ की सीमा पर स्थित है।

A. दक्षिण मध्य रेलवे (SCR) क्षेत्र का मुख्यालय सिकंदराबाद में है।
B. पूर्वी तट रेलवे (ECoR) क्षेत्र का मुख्यालय भुवनेश्वर में है।
C. दक्षिण रेलवे क्षेत्र का मुख्यालय बेंगलुरु में है।
उपरोक्त में से कौन से कथन सही हैं?

questions.question_english:
50. Evaluate the following statements regarding
Railway Zones in India:
A. The South Central Railway (SCR) zone is
headquartered in Secunderabad.
B. The East Coast Railway (ECoR) zone is
headquartered in Bhubaneswar.
C. The Southern Railway zone is headquartered in
Bengaluru.
Which of the statements above is/are
correct?
questions.explanation_english: Indian Railways is organized into administrative operational zones, each headquartered in major urban rail hubs. The South Central Railway zone is indeed headquartered in Secunderabad, Telangana. The East Coast Railway zone has its headquarters in Bhubaneswar, Odisha. However, the Southern Railway zone is headquartered in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, not Bengaluru, which is the headquarters for the South Western Railway zone. Therefore, only statements A and B are correct.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। भारतीय रेलवे को प्रशासनिक संचालन क्षेत्रों में विभाजित किया गया है, जिनका मुख्यालय प्रमुख शहरी रेलवे केंद्रों में होता है। दक्षिण मध्य रेलवे क्षेत्र का मुख्यालय सिकंदराबाद, तेलंगाना में है। पूर्वी तट रेलवे क्षेत्र का मुख्यालय भुवनेश्वर, ओडिशा में है। हालाँकि, दक्षिण रेलवे क्षेत्र का मुख्यालय चेन्नई, तमिलनाडु में है, जबकि बेंगलुरु दक्षिण पश्चिम रेलवे क्षेत्र का मुख्यालय है। इसलिए, केवल कथन A और B सही हैं।

questions.question_english: 64. The Hirakud Dam, one of the longest earth dams in the world, is constructed across which river?
questions.explanation_english: The Hirakud Dam is a massive multipurpose river valley project constructed across the Mahanadi River near Sambalpur in Odisha. Commissioned in the 1950s, it features one of the longest earthen dam structures in the world, stretching over twenty-five kilometers including dykes. The dam provides essential flood control across the coastal plains of Odisha while supplying water for extensive canal irrigation and hydroelectric power generation.

Shelterbelts, or windbreaks, constitute a key soil
conservation technique applied in arid and semi-arid flatlands. This practice involves planting
dense, systematic rows of trees and shrubs along
agricultural field perimeters perpendicular to
prevailing wind direction. By breaking wind

questions.explanation_english: The Indus, Sutlej, and Brahmaputra rivers are classic examples of antecedent drainage systems that predated the Himalayan uplift and cut through rising mountain ranges. The Indus River originates near Lake Manasarovar from the Bokhar Chu glacier in Tibet. However, the Brahmaputra River enters India in Arunachal Pradesh under the name Siang or Dihang, whereas Dibang is one of its major left-bank tributaries.
